whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Dryclean Care for T-Shirts?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Home machines rub fibres against each other, fade colour and pull garments out of shape a little more every wash. Here is why professional dryclean care makes the difference:

points.title: Colour Stays True
points.desc: Solvent cleaning does not bleed dye the way hot water and detergent do, so darks stay dark and prints stay sharp.

points.title: Fit & Shape Hold
points.desc: No spin cycle to twist seams or stretch necklines and waistbands out of shape.

points.title: Less Fibre Wear
points.desc: A low-friction dryclean cycle means less pilling, fuzzing and thinning at elbows, collars and seats.

points.title: Oils Actually Lift
points.desc: Body oils and deodorant build-up dissolve in dryclean solvent where a cold home wash leaves them behind.

points.title: A Finish You Can See
points.desc: Pressed on a steam finishing table, not a domestic iron, so seams sit flat and fabric keeps its drape.

points.title: Checked Before & After
points.desc: Buttons, seams and stains are checked when the piece arrives and again before it leaves.

stainTreatment.title: Tough Stains? We Treat Them Before the Dryclean.
stainTreatment.subtitle: These are the marks we see most often on T-shirts. Each one is assessed and pre-treated before the main clean.

categories.name: Food & Beverage
categories.detail: Tea, coffee, curry, gravy, sauces and oil drips

categories.name: Sweat & Body Oils
categories.detail: Collar and underarm build-up, yellowing and odour

categories.name: Deodorant Marks
categories.detail: White streaks and stiff underarm residue

categories.name: Ink & Pen
categories.detail: Pen marks near pockets and cuffs

categories.name: Dust & Commute Grime
categories.detail: Grey cuffs, hems and seat areas from daily wear

stainTreatment.disclaimer: Treatment results depend on the type of stain, fabric condition, age of the stain and any previous treatment. We use professional spot-lifting techniques, but complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every aged or heat-set mark.

detailCare.title: Every Detail Matters
detailCare.subtitle: Here is how the Wash4You studio treats the parts of your T-shirts that matter most:

details.title: Necklines
details.desc: Necklines and ribbing are shaped so they do not stretch open.

details.title: Prints
details.desc: Printed areas are never pressed directly, so prints do not crack or stick.

details.title: Polo Collars
details.desc: Polo collars and plackets are pressed flat and even.

details.title: Buttons & Fasteners
details.desc: Checked on arrival; loose buttons are flagged before cleaning so nothing is lost in the machine.

details.title: Colour Care
details.desc: Darks, whites and prints are assessed separately so colour never transfers between garments.

details.title: Finishing
details.desc: Steam-pressed to the garment's natural shape rather than flattened into hard creases.

faqs.q: How long does T-shirt dry cleaning take?
faqs.a: Steam Press and Dryclean & Press turnaround is confirmed when we collect your order.

faqs.q: Should I choose dryclean or steam press?
faqs.a: Choose Steam Press when the piece is already clean and just needs the creases out. Choose Dryclean & Press when it has been worn, has stains or smells, or needs a proper hygienic clean.

faqs.q: Will the print on my T-shirt be damaged?
faqs.a: No. Printed areas are cleaned gently and pressed from the reverse, or not pressed at all, so prints do not crack, fade or stick to the iron.

faqs.q: Can you remove stains from T-shirts?
faqs.a: Visible stains are identified and pre-treated before the main clean. Results depend on the type and age of the stain, the fabric and any earlier home treatment, so complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every mark.
